column1: # How often a word is written in English, per million words, for the twenty
# thousand commonest of them. Counts from Peter Norvig's count_1w.txt, which
# comes off the Google Web Trillion Word Corpus; turned into a rate here so
# that nothing has to divide by the size of a corpus it cannot see, and cut to
# words of three letters and up because nothing shorter is measured against it.
